implemented_requirements.requirement: Initialize 8x8 board with standard starting position
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.__init__ creates an 8x8 board and places the four initial discs at (3,3), (4,4) white and (3,4), (4,3) black.
Methods _flips_for_move, is_valid_move, and valid_moves compute and return all squares that would flip at least one opponent disc.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Flip opponent discs when a move is applied
implemented_requirements.evidence: apply_move calls _flips_for_move, places the new disc, and iterates over the returned list to set each captured disc to the current player's colour.
self.current_player is toggled with self._opponent after each successful move; passes are handled in the main loop.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect end of game when board is full or no valid moves remain for either player
implemented_requirements.evidence: run() checks _board_full() and also checks valid_moves for both players; breaks the loop when neither can move.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display current score during play and at game end
implemented_requirements.evidence: Method _display prints black and white counts; final score is printed after the loop in run().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Console interaction for two local players (input parsing, move prompts, quit option)
implemented_requirements.evidence: run() prints prompts, reads input via _read_input, parses with _parse_input, and handles 'q' to quit.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Handle passes when a player has no valid moves
implemented_requirements.evidence: If valid_moves(self.current_player) is empty, the code checks opponent's moves and either passes the turn or ends the game.

judge.summary: The provided code implements a complete, functional Reversi (Othello) game: board setup, automatic move validation, disc flipping, turn alternation, pass handling, end‑game detection, and score display are all present and appear correct. The code is self‑contained, uses only the Python standard library, and should run without modification, meeting the benchmark requirements.
